segments.name: Consumer finance
products: Optional payment and collateral protection insurance
segments.description: Provides secured and unsecured installment loans and complementary insurance products to customers with limited access to consumer credit.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reportable segment, which is the consumer finance segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay interest and fees on fixed-rate, fixed-term installment loans, and premiums for optional payment and collateral protection insurance.
revenueModel.evidence: In 2025, 2024, and 2023, interest and fee income from large loans contributed $382.9 million, $337.7 million, and $323.9 million, respectively, to our total revenue.
